name: Cozy Dream Home
derivedFrom: reference: House Flipper + Design Home — warm cozy home-renovation mobile game, semi-realistic stylized 3D

artDirection.theme: warm cozy American living-room home renovation, soft inviting interior

negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no UI
semi-realistic stylized, NOT a gritty literal photograph, no harsh photographic grain
no people, no pets, no hands
no harsh black cast shadows, no fisheye or wide-angle distortion

assets.subject: a cozy warm American living-room interior seen in 3/4 perspective from slightly above eye level, looking into the room. The CENTRE-FOREGROUND floor is EMPTY and clean (bare light honey-oak wood planks, NO couch, NO rug, NO carpet, nothing on the centre floor). Back wall has a large framed landscape painting on the left and a bright window with soft warm daylight on the right; a tall potted palm plant stands on the floor in the back-left corner; a slim floor lamp in the back-right corner. BOTH side walls have a wide DOORLESS open passage (open archway) leading into a softly sunlit adjacent room. Soft cozy global illumination, calm, inviting, premium but homey

a cozy two-seat sofa upholstered in warm caramel-brown fabric with two plump seat cushions, soft rounded armrests and short wooden legs, seen in 3/4 view from slightly above and in front, soft and inviting

a seamless top-down flat bird's-eye swatch of plush WALL-TO-WALL broadloom carpet in a soft warm neutral greige (warm grey-beige) tone, uniform dense cut-pile fibre texture, subtle natural pile variation, absolutely NO pattern, NO border, NO motif, NO seams; the carpet texture FILLS THE ENTIRE SQUARE FRAME completely edge-to-edge — absolutely NO background, NO margin; even soft flat lighting, looks like real soft wall-to-wall carpet

ONE single long old DAMAGED hardwood floorboard plank seen straight from DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down), natural wood grain running vertically top-to-bottom; the plank is genuinely WORN and DAMAGED and clearly needs replacing: dull faded finish, several deep SPLITS and CRACKS running along the grain, scuffs and greyed water stains, AND clear TERMITE damage — small round bore holes, winding insect-tunnel galleries, and clusters of tiny pinholes eaten into the wood, plus a couple of chipped gouged spots; old and visibly damaged, but still a warm semi-realistic cozy wood plank in the room's soft style — NOT a black grimy barn board, NO bright green mould; the single plank fills the whole frame edge-to-edge

ONE single long brand-new warm honey-oak wooden floorboard plank seen straight from DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down), clean straight natural wood grain running vertically top-to-bottom, smooth subtle grain, soft satin finish catching gentle warm light, pristine flawless and inviting; the single plank fills the whole frame edge-to-edge
a single red steel crowbar pry-bar hand tool, clean instantly recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a single fresh honey-oak wooden floorboard plank, clean instantly recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a single paint roller with a green handle applying glossy clear floor finish, clean instantly recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a friendly flooring-company emblem: a simple warm house silhouette sitting on a small swatch of wooden plank floor inside a soft rounded badge, wordless icon only, perfectly centered and symmetric
